title: [Free] Merge Idle War: An incremental Elementals Merge game with an infinite War raging!
author: CreativeProblem7803
selftext:
**Playable Link:** [https://playgama.com/game/merge-idle-war?clid=p\_7ab79d29-c32e-4ace-bbe6-1d42ece7c5bb](https://playgama.com/game/merge-idle-war?clid=p_7ab79d29-c32e-4ace-bbe6-1d42ece7c5bb)

**Platform:** Web Browser / Mobile Browser, playgama mobile app

**Description:** 

Merge elemental units into a **50-tier** army and crush endless enemy waves. Combos, fever gold rushes, meteor storms — the war never stops!

The game is ***inherently incremental*** as you constantly strive to merge into the next higher tier unit and you are rewarded for it with a fancy spotlight.

The **upgrade system** is also *incremental* and just as essential for a faster progress in the merge chain.

**Bosses** with unique skills await you every 5 levels and there are rare gifts occasionally flying by.

Are you going to become the **#1** on the leaderboard?

  
**Comment:**

Feel free to check it out and give feedback here.

I'd love to get feedback on what is good and what is bad on my game. Please don't play it if you are not into merge mechanics.

**AI Disclosure:**  
Generative AI (Gemini) was used for the elemental units and background designs, I have automated the workflow due to the high amount of unit assets needed. The UI itself is done by me as I am a Web Frontend Engineer (11+ years professionally).   
I used a Coding Agent to help me with Unit testing and end-to-end testing, making my coding project a stable endevour.

comments.author: Lordxb
comments.body: Game needs work, your models need idle, attack etc then this looks like a good game!!

replies.author: CreativeProblem7803
replies.body: To be honest, I wanted to circumvent that as I have 50 different player units, giving idle and attack to each of them will be a chore, but you are absolutely right, as of right now they dont look too realistic without the animations.
